fees.notes: Official UIS international fee for Ijazah Sarjana Muda Perakaunan (Bachelor of Accounting (Honours)) (programme code bb04), last published on study.uis.edu.my (capture 20240722194758): RM57,994 total, an all-inclusive package covering registration, facilities & welfare, tuition & assessment, accommodation (Dormitory D, full-time only) and graduation. UIS's current programme page (https://study.uis.edu.my/bb04, accessed 2026-09-18) says tuition fee information will be updated soon, so this is the latest officially published international figure. fees.per_year = total / official duration.
